test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

SLACKEN
solution: The correct answer is '**Intensify**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Slacken**' is '**Intensify**'. • **Slacken**: to become or make something slower or less active. धीमा हो जाना या कर देना • *Example: He **slackened** off his pace towards the end of the race.* • **Intensify**: to become or to make something greater or stronger. तीव्रतर, प्रबल या उग्रतर हो जाना या कर देना • *Example: Fighting in the region has **intensified**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Intensify.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Relax**: to rest while you are doing something enjoyable, especially after work or effort. [आराम फ़रमाना, विश्राम करना (विशेषतः काम या श्रम के बाद)] • **Retard**: to delay something or make its development or progress slower. [(प्रगति या विकास) धीमा करना; देर करना, विलंब करना; बाधा डालना[ • **Weaken**: to become less strong; to make somebody/something less strong. [कमज़ोर हो जाना; (व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को) कमज़ोर कर देना] 3b:T688, The correct answer is** 'choose from'.**
